parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ "mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and trashed=false and name contains 'Stor' and (" + (($json.files || []).map(f => "'" + f.id + "' in parents").join(' or ') || "'none' in parents") + ')' }}

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ "mimeType contains 'video/' and trashed=false and (" + (($json.files || []).map(f => "'" + f.id + "' in parents").join(' or ') || "'none' in parents") + ')' }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Settings').first().json.CLAUDE_MODEL, max_tokens: 1500, system: $json.system, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.userContent }] }) }}
